rows.name: KARMA WANGMO HOMESTAY
rows.description:
Karma Wangmo Homestay stands out for its authentic Bhutanese hospitality, offering guests a unique and immersive cultural experience in the heart of Phobjikha Valley. Unlike conventional hotels, our homestay provides a warm, family-like atmosphere where visitors can engage with local traditions and customs. Our five cozy, well-furnished rooms ensure a comfortable stay while maintaining the charm of a traditional Bhutanese home.

What truly sets us apart is our commitment to offering genuine Bhutanese experiences—our traditional cuisine is made with fresh, locally sourced ingredients, providing a true taste of Bhutan. Guests can also enjoy a revitalizing hotstone bath, an ancient Bhutanese wellness practice known for its therapeutic benefits. Additionally, our location in Phobjikha Valley provides breathtaking panoramic views, perfect for those seeking tranquility, nature, and a break from modern distractions. Whether you’re here for the serene landscapes, rich culture, or a peaceful retreat, Karma Wangmo Homestay ensures an unforgettable experience.
